doc: A built castle part (design/planner.md, Castles): its mesh, moving parts (banners, smoke), collision, and its lot, box, doorway, and marker.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Height, metres (conformance).

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Conformance radius, metres: the farthest it reaches from the origin.

fields.name: fire_points
fields.doc: Where fires burn, metres: hearths, forges, torches, braziers (lit), and points over its roof and walls that burn when it does.

fields.name: fire_configs
fields.doc: Each fire point's fire config (fire_config's id).

fields.name: fire_lit
fields.doc: Each fire point: 1 always lit (a hearth, a torch), 0 only while the building burns, 2 its smoke only (a chimney or a smoke hole: the hearth's smoke without its flames).

fields.name: footprint
fields.doc: Which lot it stands on: small (rect6x5), medium (rect8x6), large (rect10x7), or keep (rect8x8).

fields.name: footprint_cells
fields.doc: The round footprint that holds it, for plotters that know only those: 7, 19, 37, 61, 91, 127, or 169 cells.

fields.name: footprint_radius
fields.doc: The radius its round footprint must hold, metres.

fields.name: cells
fields.doc: The cells it stands on, as q, r pairs (axial, pointy-top, 1 m cells), relative to the cell under the origin; +z faces its road.

fields.name: doors
fields.doc: The cells just outside its doors, as q, r pairs relative to the cell under the origin (+z its front): the footprint's, so every type on a lot has the same. A planner keeps them a clear way.

fields.name: lot_min
fields.doc: The lot's box, its low corner, metres: the cells' bounds on the ground (the box conformance a planner's plot matches).

fields.name: lot_max
fields.doc: The lot's box, its high corner, metres: the cells' bounds on the ground, up to the building's top.

fields.name: guide_cells
fields.doc: Every lot this pipeline has, for the viewer to outline on the ground and compare: group, q, r triples (a group is one lot), relative to the cell under the origin.

fields.name: guide_tones
fields.doc: Each guide group's tone: 0 the lot it stands on, 2 the rest.

fields.name: doorway
fields.doc: Where the player stands to use its main door, metres, on the ground just outside it (a centre's: in front of it).

fields.name: doorway_heading
fields.doc: Which way the door faces, degrees from +Z toward +X.

fields.name: marker
fields.doc: Where the command view puts its marker or label: above its middle.

fields.name: bones
fields.doc: The moving parts, animated by house_animate.

fields.name: positions
fields.doc: Vertex positions, rest pose, metres.

fields.name: normals
fields.doc: Vertex normals.

fields.name: indices
fields.doc: Triangle list.

fields.name: bone_a
fields.doc: First bone per vertex.

fields.name: bone_b
fields.doc: Second bone per vertex.

fields.name: bone_w
fields.doc: Weight of bone_b per vertex (0 = all bone_a).

fields.name: colors
fields.doc: Vertex colour, packed RGBA (red in the lowest byte).

fields.name: collision
fields.doc: What collides: walls, towers, turrets solid; the doorway a sensor named doorway.
